detail_anon_gate: anonymous GET -> 302 /Login.aspx?ReturnUrl=... (wi/samples/t1_detail_native_*, t1_detail_20261026T191411Z.html, t1_detail_afterpost_* + headers; 59,365 B login page 'requires a login'); 4/4 URL shapes gated (DETAILS.md §3)

detail_auth.field_pattern: span#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder_MainBase_Label_<Name>, 48 value ids in fixture (fixtures/WI/detail_1.html; wi/REPORT.md Addendum; DETAILS.md §3)
detail_auth.transport_note: browser capture 82,284 B; httpx replay ~71-74 KB field-identical at runtime but not saved (wi/scripts/22_replay_details.py prints only)

detail_auth_examples.DutiesText_len: 2576 chars (full description; observed 2,576/3,855/3,642 across 3 orders per wi/REPORT.md Addendum)
detail_auth_examples.JobTitle: REHAB TECH, HFMH - HFM REHAB PT

detail_missing_vs_list: no anonymous description/salary/hours/requirements/apply URL without login (wi/REPORT.md §Response Schema)

list_grid.access_derived: href contains 'OrderNumber=' -> public_list_only else partner_ref/login_required via title regex (wi/scripts/13_parse_rows.py)
list_grid.city: tr span[id$='lblCity'] e.g. 'Manitowoc' (may be out-of-state NLX rows; never empty in 201 sampled)
list_grid.date_posted: tr span[id$='lblDatePosted'] MM/DD/YYYY e.g. '10/13/2026' (NOT the feed sort key)
list_grid.detail_href_partner: ../../Login.aspx?ReturnUrl=... (USNLX/wisc.jobs rows; fixtures/WI/facet_onet.html has none on p1, wi/samples/t1_onet29_wd2_check.html has WALGREENS/CENTENE examples)
list_grid.employer:
first line of div.InfoNoteSearch before first
e.g. 'FROEDTERT' (never empty in 201 sampled)
list_grid.header_row: tr.theme_header, 3 th: Title/Location/Date Posted, each a Sort$ postback (fixtures/WI/search_page_1.html)
list_grid.job_number_native: href OrderNumber=(\d+) 9-digit zero-padded e.g. '004073143' — stable dedupe key
list_grid.pay: div.InfoNoteSearch line starting 'Pay:' e.g. '$18.42' / 'Based on Experience'; null for 8/201 sampled (wi/REPORT.md §Response Schema)
list_grid.source: div.InfoNoteSearch line starting 'Source:' e.g. 'Job Center of Wisconsin' / 'USNLX' / 'wisc.jobs'
list_grid.title: tr div.TableData > a text e.g. 'REHAB TECH, HFMH - HFM REHAB PT' (anchor class 'Attention no-jquery-tip'; take anchor text only, a Hot-Job may follow)

list_header.pager_targets: tr.pad a[href] regex Page\$(\d+); anchor text '[ ... ]' = next 10-page block jump (fixtures/WI/search_page_1.html: Page$2..Page$10 + [...])
list_header.too_many_flag: #ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder_MainBase_Label_TooManyResults non-empty => partition saturated ('More than 500 jobs were found...')
list_header.total: #ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder_MainBase_Label_RowCount e.g. '500+ Jobs Found. (525+ openings)'; parse ^(\d+)\+? Jobs Found\. \((\d+)\+? openings\)$; '+' => floor not total

stable_id: OrderNumber 9-digit (native) / title-derived composite (partner); job_key = <id_kind>:<job_number> in wi/data/probe.sqlite jobs table (326 instances / 201 distinct)
